_comment: Item model for block 31 (minecraft:grass), whose three metas are the dead shrub, short grass and
the fern. StationAPI keys item models by ITEM, not by damage - ItemModels.getModel(stack) looks up
stack.getItem() - so the per-meta split has to happen through overrides, which its arsenic renderer
The 'meta' predicate is StationAPI's own, and it only answers for an item whose hasSubtypes() is
true - which mixin.item.TallPlantSubtypesMixin is what makes true for this one. With the option off
the predicate returns -Infinity, no override matches, and every variant draws as the base model,
Order matters and is ascending on purpose: ModelOverrideList tests value >= threshold and builds its
array in reverse, so the LAST matching entry wins. meta 2 matches both and lands on the fern.
Base model is the dead shrub because it is meta 0, and meta 0 is what a stack that never had a
variant carries. Tinting is not decided here - every layer0 quad carries tintindex 0 (that is what
item/generated does with its first layer), and compat.stationapi.StationApiItemColors answers white
for the shrub and the grass colour for the other two.
